title: Aligning Multimodal LLM with Human Preference: A Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying existing multimodal evaluation benchmarks (e.g., MJ-Bench, Bingo) that assess broad issues regarding bias, fairness, safety, and interference in model responses.
Reviewing evaluation techniques (such as AlpacaEval-V2) that implement simple regression analysis to control for verbosity or length bias during automated self-assessments.
Discussing the limitations of using external models (like CLIP or GPT-4) to score text-image matching or serve as reward models, noting their susceptibility to inherent model biases.
